'''Sabersicle treats''' were a frozen [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]]. [[Kaori Batta]] believed that the harsh weather on [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]] was capable of freezing an individual like a sabersicle treat.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
